4-Achs-Sätze mit X/Y/Z und A zusammen: V: 4-axis blocks with X/Y/Z and A together: many controls count degrees like millimeters there, so the cutter runs too slow or too fast on the workpiece. “Converted” writes the F value so that such a control runs the desired feed at the cutting edge. “Inverse time” switches to G93 and gives 1/time in every block – unambiguous if the control knows G93.
GRBL 1.1 steuert nur X, Y und Z: Für die: GRBL 1.1 controls only X, Y and Z: the rotary axis A needs a 4-axis variant (e.g. grblHAL) – otherwise the program stops at the first A word
Sätze mit X/Y/Z und A zusammen: Der Vors: Blocks with X/Y/Z and A together: the feed is in mm/min in the program, but many controls count degrees like millimeters there – set the post processor setting “Feed with rotary axis” to “converted” or “inverse time (G93)”
